config.smile_toolb.tooltip.advanced_bar_: Tab shows the locator bar; a jumpable mount shows the charge bar.

config.smile_toolb.tooltip.force_experie: Suppresses the locator bar so the experience bar stays visible.
config.smile_toolb.tooltip.include_onlin: Online voices need a network; more natural, slightly slower first line.
config.smile_toolb.tooltip.keep_chat_dra: Restores unsent text after reopening chat or rejoining shortly; keyed by server address.

config.smile_toolb.tooltip.rate: 100% is normal speed; applies from the next message.
